snippet.title: I can offer you Flowers - relaxing cosy game
snippet.description:
Demo release trailer! Coming on 10.19.26

Wishlist the game on Steam : https://store.steampowered.com/app/4235290/I_can_offer_you_Flowers/
Join Discord for playtest!

In 🌷 I can offer you flowers 🌷 you are a florist who carefully selects flowers for each request. You solve relaxing puzzles and handle cute flowers!

📝 Your like and comment will help us grow
💌 Any feedback you'll send to us is highly valuable!

🐝 Features:
- Become a florist in a community center
- Select, arrange, and organise flowers for each order
- Take your time to find the combinations that best suit each situation
- Meet touching characters who are sharing a special moment with their loved ones
- Become a member of this small, caring community
- English and French available

🌿 State of development 
Demo coming on 10.19.26
Experience your first two months (March and April) in this demo, featuring 12 levels and nearly an hour of gameplay!

We are working on more levels to create a 3-hour experience, including around 20 characters and many more flowers. We also plan to include more side gameplay, such as preparing the bouquet visuals. 
Join us on Discord to participate to playtest :)

Credits : 
Game by GigiLili, Segosaurus et LePoulet
Music by Elodie Côme
Trailer by Maëlle ELIZABETH
